whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Om Bihar Karate & Dance Academy,

I noticed your academy has stellar 5.0★ reviews in Ashok Nagar, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new student admissions and batch inquiries.

Maine aapke academy ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, martial arts & dance classes, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/ombihar

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team Om Bihar Karate & Dance Academy, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Om Bihar Karate & Dance Academy) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and mobile-first speed for parents in Ashok Nagar, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact batch timings, actual studio photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
